name: HH breakout 09 — channel break with trailing runner (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: the Donchian break convexity again (rare multi-week trend catches carry a low win-rate but fat payoff), but the distinct upgrade here is a STANDALONE trailing stop (exit.trailing_stop) armed only after a profit cushion — the Turtle 'let winners run' rule made explicit. Rather than a fixed take-profit that caps the fat right tail, we ride the trend and let the trailing stop (distance a ParamRef) lock in gains behind the favourable extreme once arm_after_profit is cleared, so the few big winners are not truncated. Enter long on a range_position break with adx above a trend floor on the 4h clock. This is economically distinct from variants 07/08 because the EXIT structure — trail-the-winner vs range-re-entry vs ATR-stop — is what determines whether the fat-tail payoff is actually harvested. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if the trailing runner does not beat the fixed take-profit exit net of fees on the holdout (the trail just gives back gains in chop), OR if it fails to beat buy-and-hold, OR if arm_after_profit has to be set so high that almost no trade ever arms the trail (the mechanism never engages).
catalyst: new-high break, ride the trend with a profit-armed trailing stop
